title: Tailwise Autoship Subscriptions per Customer, Item and Pet
content:
**Tailwise Autoship program terms — holding several subscriptions**

1. A customer may hold any number of Tailwise Autoship subscriptions. There is no portfolio cap: no maximum number of subscriptions per customer applies.
2. Each subscription carries exactly one item number, on its own delivery frequency.
3. No other subscription of the same customer for the same item number and the same pet is in status pending first shipment, active, paused, payment hold or prescription hold. A request that would duplicate such a subscription is handled as a change (quantity or frequency) to the existing subscription instead of a new enrollment.
4. A cancelled subscription never blocks a new one for the same item.
5. When the program's pet profile setting is Yes, the subscription is linked to a pet profile of the same customer.
6. Subscriptions for different pets of the same customer are separate even when the item number is the same.

The facts for clauses 3 to 6 are read from the company's records: the customer, item number, pet and status of each existing subscription, and the owner of each pet profile. They are checked before the enrollment is made.

## Is it a duplicate? Decision table

| Existing subscription of the same customer | Same item number | Same pet | Its status | Outcome for a new enrollment request |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes | pending first shipment, active, paused, payment hold or prescription hold | Duplicate: handled as a quantity or frequency change to the existing subscription |
| Yes | Yes | Yes | cancelled | Not blocked |
| Yes | Yes | No (another pet) | any | Separate subscription; not a duplicate |
| Yes | No (another item) | any | any | Separate subscription; not a duplicate |

## Points of judgement

- **A paused subscription for the same item and pet** is still a live subscription under clause 3, so a second enrollment for that item and pet is a duplicate.
- **Two dogs on one profile eating the same kibble** may each have their own Tailwise Autoship subscription for that item number (clause 6).
- **Pet profile.** On Autoship Custom Meal Plan, Autoship Pharmacy and Autoship Compounded Pharmacy the pet profile setting is Yes, so the subscription is linked to one of the customer's own pet profiles; a pet profile held by another customer does not meet clause 5.
